name: Heavy webbing vest
description: A heavy nylon vest covered in rows of webbing for attaching pouches and holsters.

CHECK VOLUME (x6): the reference counts the vest packed down; laid out flat it spans a wide box of air. It has no pockets of its own; pouches attach to seven webbing points. On the model the chest points sit on the upper rows of the left and right front panels, the belly points on the lower rows, the side points on the cummerbund webbing either side, and the back point on the back panel under the vest. The worn look is pending: no worn model is authored.
